invariants: category.monthly_budget must be non-negative if provided
category.icon must be a string or None
expense.expense_date must be a valid ISO date string
expense.category_id must reference an existing category
budget.category_id must reference an existing category
budget.month must be in YYYY-MM format
budget.category_id and month must be unique across all budgets
expense_date must be <= current date when adding an expense
expense.amount_cents must not exceed budget limit for its category and month when adding
all monetary values must be stored as integers (cents)
